decisions.rationale: Leading Scarf Tsareena + Mental Herb Mimikyu blocks priority (Fake Out, Prankster Taunt/Quash) via Queenly Majesty and guarantees Trick Room setting. In the back, Garganacl (Purifying Salt) cleanly 4x OHKOs Charizard-Y with Stone Edge and provides status immunity, while Life Orb Armarouge abuses Sun with boosted Armor Cannon and Powerful Expanding Force under Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Sun Offense (Charizard-Y/Venusaur/Raichu/Kingambit/Tauros-Aqua/Sableye). Plan: Lead Tsareena + Mimikyu. Queenly Majesty shuts down Fake Out/Prankster/Sucker Punch, enabling guaranteed TR setting. Bring Armarouge and Garganacl in back to dominate under Trick Room. Garganacl's Stone Edge OHKOs Charizard-Y with 4x damage and Purifying Salt blocks status; Armarouge exploits opponent's Sun with Flash Fire + LO Armor Cannon / Expanding Force.

decisions.rationale: Charizard-Venusaur applies immediate sun pressure into Tsareena and the Trick Room core while threatening fast Sleep Powder. Raichu offers speed control and Encore once Tsareena is removed; Kingambit is the strongest backline punishment for Mimikyu, Slowking-Galar, and Armarouge.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Choice Scarf Tsareena with Queenly Majesty; Mental Herb Mimikyu Trick Room; Life Orb Armarouge with Wide Guard; Lum Scrafty Intimidate/Fake Out; Leftovers Garganacl Wide Guard; Sitrus Regenerator Galarian Slowking Trick Room/Chilly Reception. Respect Queenly Majesty: priority and Prankster plans fail while Tsareena is active. Their main modes are fast Scarf Tsareena pressure and multiple Trick Room setters supported by Wide Guard/Fake Out. Preserve Mega Charizard Y weather pressure and Venusaur’s Chlorophyll mode; Kingambit is valuable versus their Psychic/Ghost setters.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Tsareena)
decisions.rationale: Mimikyu sets guaranteed Trick Room thanks to Disguise absorbing any initial single attack. Switching Tsareena out to Armarouge safely absorbs Charizard-Y's expected Sun-boosted Heat Wave with Flash Fire, granting Armarouge a Flash Fire boost while protecting the slot from incoming Fire/Grass damage. Under Trick Room on Turn 2, Armarouge will outspeed both foes and exert massive pressure.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 vs Sun Offense (Charizard-Y / Venusaur / Raichu / Kingambit / Tauros-Aqua / Sableye). Core plan: Set Trick Room using Mimikyu's Disguise. Pivot Armarouge into Fire attacks to activate Flash Fire in Sun. Under TR, Armarouge and Garganacl dominate with Life Orb boosted attacks and 4x Stone Edge into Charizard-Y. Purifying Salt Garganacl counters status attempts.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolve to establish sun, enabling Venusaur to outrun Mimikyu and attempt to deny Trick Room with Sleep Powder. Heat Wave pressures Tsareena heavily while breaking Mimikyu’s Disguise before it can act if Sleep Powder misses.
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Scarf Queenly Majesty Tsareena; Mental Herb Trick Room Mimikyu; Life Orb Flash Fire Armarouge with Wide Guard; Lum Intimidate/Fake Out Scrafty; Leftovers Garganacl Wide Guard; Sitrus Regenerator Galarian Slowking Trick Room/Chilly Reception. Their modes center on fast Tsareena and Trick Room setters with Wide Guard/Fake Out. Queenly Majesty blocks priority while Tsareena is active. Preserve Mega Charizard Y sun plus Chlorophyll Venusaur when possible; Kingambit is important into Psychic/Ghost setters. Account for Flash Fire and Wide Guard before committing Fire spread attacks.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Mimikyu-Busted)
Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Armarouge)
decisions.rationale: Armarouge's Wide Guard (+3 priority) completely blocks Charizard-Y's Sun-boosted Heat Wave, protecting sleeping Mimikyu from spread chip while Armarouge remains safe due to Flash Fire and quad-resistances. Mimikyu attempts Trick Room; if it wakes up, TR sets up cleanly. If it stays asleep, Wide Guard keeps it alive to attempt TR again next turn.
decisions.notebook:

Core plan: Set Trick Room with Mimikyu. Armarouge absorbs Fire attacks via Flash Fire in Sun. Under TR, Armarouge and Garganacl dominate (Stone Edge 4x into Charizard-Y). Purifying Salt Garganacl blocks status attempts.

decisions.rationale: Garganacl is immune to status (Sleep Powder) thanks to Purifying Salt and threatens Charizard-Mega-Y with a 4x super-effective STAB Stone Edge, while also providing Wide Guard support. Tsareena is heavily vulnerable to Charizard-Y's Sun-boosted Heat Wave and Air Slash.

Game 1 vs Sun Offense (Charizard-Y / Venusaur / Raichu / Kingambit / Tauros-Aqua / Sableye).
Key notes:
- Charizard-Y has Drought, Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Air Slash, Protect.
- Venusaur has Chlorophyll, Focus Sash, Energy Ball, Sludge Bomb, Sleep Powder, Protect.
- Armarouge active with Flash Fire boost in Sun. Life Orb Armor Cannon threatens massive damage.
- Garganacl Purifying Salt blocks Sleep Powder and status, standard Rock STAB threatens Charizard-Y.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Mimikyu with the strongest available single-target special attacks to deny its Trick Room as reliably as possible. Armarouge can only remove Venusaur through Focus Sash this turn, while leaving Mimikyu alive risks an immediate Trick Room reversal.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s revealed core: Scarf Queenly Majesty Tsareena; Mental Herb Mimikyu with Trick Room; Life Orb Flash Fire Armarouge with Wide Guard; Lum Intimidate/Fake Out Scrafty; Leftovers Garganacl Wide Guard; Sitrus Regenerator Galarian Slowking Trick Room/Chilly Reception. Their modes center on fast Tsareena and Trick Room setters with Wide Guard/Fake Out. Preserve Mega Charizard Y sun plus Chlorophyll Venusaur when possible; Kingambit is important into Psychic/Ghost setters. Account for Flash Fire and Wide Guard before committing Fire spread attacks.

decisions.rationale: Armarouge uses Protect to safely block Venusaur's Chlorophyll-boosted attacks or Sleep Powder. Charizard-Mega-Y is locked into releasing Solar Beam from turn 2 charging and cannot Protect. Garganacl's Purifying Salt renders it immune to Sleep Powder, allowing it to survive Solar Beam and KO Charizard-Y with STAB Stone Edge (4x super-effective).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Double-target Garganacl with Venusaur’s faster Energy Ball followed by Charizard’s charged Solar Beam. Their combined minimum damage exceeds its HP, removing the Rock attacker before it can threaten Charizard; both attacks bypass Wide Guard.

Armarouge's Sun- and Flash Fire-boosted Armor Cannon deals massive damage to Venusaur, while Tsareena's Knock Off targets Venusaur to strip its Focus Sash and chip it. Eliminating or crippling Venusaur removes the primary Chlorophyll disrupter.
decisions.notebook:
Game 1 vs Sun Offense (Charizard-Y / Venusaur / Raichu / Kingambit / Tauros-Aqua / Sableye).
Key notes:
- Charizard-Y (Mega Evolved, Drought): Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Air Slash, Protect.
- Venusaur (Focus Sash, Chlorophyll): Energy Ball, Sludge Bomb, Sleep Powder, Protect.
- Armarouge: Flash Fire active, Life Orb, Quiet.
- Tsareena: Choice Scarf, Jolly, Queenly Majesty.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur moves before Scarf Tsareena; Sludge Bomb plus Air Slash guarantees the KO by damage ranges if Air Slash connects. Removing Queenly Majesty and the fast attacker cleanly preserves Kingambit’s priority for the endgame; Venusaur’s Focus Sash absorbs Armarouge’s likely Armor Cannon.
Raichu is the lower-cost partner to expose into Armarouge while preserving Charizard to finish the remaining opposing Pokémon; its speed control and Encore also retain utility if it survives.

Armarouge is our last remaining Pokémon against Charizard-Mega-Y and Raichu. Raichu is in guaranteed KO range of Flash Fire Life Orb boosted Armor Cannon in Sun. Targeting Raichu with Armor Cannon gives the highest chance of securing a KO before the match concludes.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out prevents Armarouge from acting this turn while Charizard’s faster Air Slash has a possible KO and avoids Flash Fire/Wide Guard. If it survives, the flinch-free turn and its lowered special bulk leave a favorable cleanup.

Armarouge has revealed Armor Cannon, Expanding Force, Wide Guard, and Protect.

decisions.rationale: Armarouge is at 11% HP and outsped by both Raichu and Charizard-Y. While Game 1 is virtually lost, playing Armor Cannon into Raichu is the best active move in case of misses, rather than forfeiting prematurely.
decisions.notebook:
Game 1 lost vs Charizard-Y / Venusaur / Raichu. Key insights for Game 2:
- Opponent's Sun team relied on fast Chlorophyll Venusaur Sleep Powder + Charizard-Y heat pressure in Sun.
- Raichu provided Fake Out pressure and speed control.
- Remaining team options: Kingambit, Tauros-Aqua, Sableye.
- Adjust Game 2 lead: Need better handling of Sun turn 1. Protect/Wide Guard timings on Armarouge and Garganacl were crucial. Consider setting Trick Room with Mimikyu safely or bringing Garganacl early with Wide Guard to neutralize Charizard's Heat Wave.

decisions.rationale: Electroweb and Air Slash each independently guarantee a KO on the revealed low-HP Armarouge if they connect; using both minimizes the only relevant failure case, accuracy misses. Raichu acts first, but Air Slash covers an Electroweb miss.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s revealed core: Choice Scarf Queenly Majesty Tsareena; Mental Herb Mimikyu with Trick Room; Life Orb Flash Fire Armarouge with Armor Cannon, Expanding Force, Wide Guard, Protect; Lum Intimidate/Fake Out Scrafty; Leftovers Garganacl with Wide Guard; Sitrus Regenerator Galarian Slowking with Trick Room/Chilly Reception. Their modes center on fast Tsareena and Trick Room setters supported by Wide Guard/Fake Out. Preserve Mega Charizard Y sun plus Chlorophyll Venusaur when possible; Kingambit is important into Psychic/Ghost setters. Account for Flash Fire and Wide Guard before committing Fire spread attacks.

reflections.summary: Lost Game 1 because leading Tsareena + Mimikyu into Charizard-Y + Chlorophyll Venusaur allowed Venusaur to put Mimikyu to sleep before Trick Room was set, completely collapsing the board state under Sun offense.
reflections.adjustment: Adjust team-preview bring and leads for Game 2: Lead Garganacl alongside Armarouge or Mimikyu to utilize Wide Guard against Charizard's Heat Wave and Purifying Salt pressure, while keeping Tsareena in the back to block Raichu's Fake Out.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads Charizard-Mega-Y + Modest Chlorophyll Venusaur for fast turn-1 Sleep Powder and Sun offense; Raichu in back provides Fake Out and speed control with Electroweb. Garganacl's Purifying Salt and Wide Guard are key defense points against Venusaur/Charizard-Y. Tsareena's Queenly Majesty invalidates Raichu's Fake Out when timed properly.

reflections.summary: Won because Charizard Y/Venusaur was the right preview mode: Sleep Powder neutralized Trick Room Mimikyu, sun-boosted Solar Beam removed Garganacl, and Charizard plus Raichu cleaned Armarouge. The four brought suited this matchup; Mega Charizard Y was the correct evolution.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, keep Venusaur healthier once Trick Room is denied; do not leave it exposed to the Tsareena/Armarouge double target if Raichu can be positioned safely instead. Respect Queenly Majesty before selecting Fake Out.
reflections.notebook: Opponent can lead Choice Scarf Tsareena alongside Mental Herb Trick Room Mimikyu. Armarouge is Life Orb Flash Fire with Wide Guard, and Garganacl also has Wide Guard; avoid relying on Fire spread damage and prioritize single-target Grass pressure into Garganacl. Charizard Y/Venusaur is a strong mode into their Trick Room/Garganacl plan; retain Raichu for late-speed control and Armarouge disruption. Queenly Majesty blocks Fake Out while Tsareena is active.
